text: Sorry for the long message, it's been such a long day and I'm honestly so tired I can barely think straight. I'm staying with my niece Ayesha, she's 6, and she's had chickenpox the last couple of days, normal itchy spots, she's been fine with them otherwise, playing and eating, theek thi bilkul. But tonight her temp went up to 39.6 which seemed high to me. And then when I was putting cream on her I noticed some different spots on her legs, I think they're tiny dark red dots, almost purplish, and a couple of bits that look a bit like bruises, not like the chickenpox ones at all. My sister always says do the glass test so I pressed a glass on them and they didn't go away, I could still see them clearly through the glass. I tried it twice to be sure, maybe I'm doing it wrong, I don't know. Ammi said it's probably just the pox, but mujhe samajh nahi aa raha, they really don't look the same. I'm not sure if I'm overthinking it because I'm so exhausted. Please let me know what I should do, I don't want to wake her for no reason but I also don't want to ignore it.
